intro: Captain Garran Vimes does not recognize the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe, and sends you to Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore, who looks after the records of the Theramore guard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment.
He should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, friend. You'd like information about a specific member of the Theramore guard? Reethe, was it?
Just give me a moment to find the right book.
